fire: Small gaps in the seal could let water seep into the engine.

Colder oceans produce fewer hurricanes and therefore fewer landfalls.
As warm air rises through the chimney, it pulls cooler air in below.
A single loose wire could start a fire inside the wall.
Changes that allow the parasite to survive in cold water are uncommon.
Less snowfall means fewer avalanches and thus fewer closed roads.
When salt water flows through the filter, the membrane traps the minerals.

Colder oceans were measured by the research ship last year.

A single loose wire was hanging from the kitchen ceiling.
The parasite was first described in a paper from 1950.
Less snowfall was recorded this winter in the northern valleys.
